title: Linear Equations in Two Variables
description: Class 9 IMO — Linear Equations in Two Variables: the form ax + by + c = 0, why a solution is a pair, graphing a line, and lines parallel to the axes (x = k, y = k).

topics.title: Equations and Their Solutions
topics.concept:
What is a Linear Equation in Two Variables?

A linear equation in two variables is an equation that can be written in the form ax + by + c = 0, where a, b, and c are real numbers, and a and b are NOT both zero. The variables x and y have exponent 1 (they are linear).

Standard Form: ax + by + c = 0

Examples:

  • 2x + 3y - 6 = 0 (a=2, b=3, c=-6)
  • x - y = 5 (can be rewritten as x - y - 5 = 0)
  • y = 2x + 1 (can be rewritten as 2x - y + 1 = 0)

Key Properties:

  • A linear equation in two variables has infinitely many solutions
  • Each solution is an ordered pair (x, y) that satisfies the equation
  • When plotted on a coordinate plane, all solutions lie on a straight line

Why "Linear"?

The word "linear" comes from the Latin word "linea" meaning line. The graph of such an equation is always a straight line.

Real-Life Applications:

  • Relationship between cost and quantity (C = mx + b)
  • Distance-time relationship (d = rt)
  • Budget constraints (2x + 3y = 100)

examples.problem: Is (2, 1) a solution of x + y = 3?

examples.solution: Take x = 1 ⇒ y = 3, so (1, 3) is one of infinitely many.

recap: Form: ax + by + c = 0, a and b not both 0.
A solution is a pair (x, y); there are infinitely many.

quiz.q: A standard linear equation ax + by + c = 0 reduces to a line parallel to the x-axis if:
quiz.explanation: A line parallel to the x-axis is of the form y = k. For ax + by + c = 0 to reduce to this form, the x term must vanish, which requires coefficient a = 0 while b must be non-zero.

quiz.q: The positive solutions of the equation ax + by + c = 0 always lie in the:
quiz.explanation: Positive solutions mean both x > 0 and y > 0. In the coordinate plane, both coordinates are positive only in the 1st quadrant.

topics.title: Graph of a Linear Equation
topics.concept:
What is the Graph of a Linear Equation?

The graph of a linear equation in two variables is the set of all points (x, y) whose coordinates satisfy the equation. This graph is always a straight line.

Steps to Graph a Linear Equation:

  1. Find at least three solutions (ordered pairs) of the equation
  2. Plot these points on the Cartesian plane
  3. Draw a straight line passing through all plotted points
  4. Extend the line in both directions with arrows

Why Three Points?

Two points determine a line, but using a third point helps verify accuracy — all three should be collinear (lie on the same line).

Graphing Special Cases:

Equation TypeExampleGraph Description
y = constanty = -2Horizontal line through (0, -2)
Through originy = 2xLine passing through (0, 0)
ax + by = 02x + y = 0Line through origin

Intercepts Method:

  • x-intercept: Point where line crosses x-axis (y = 0)
  • y-intercept: Point where line crosses y-axis (x = 0)

examples.solution: x = 0 ⇒ (0, 1); x = 2 ⇒ (2, 3). Join them for the line.

examples.problem: Does the graph of x + y = 4 pass through (4, 0)?
examples.solution: 4 + 0 = 4, so yes — it is on the line.

recap: The graph of a linear equation is a straight line.
Plot two or three solution points, then join with a ruler.

quiz.q: Find the value of k if x = 3k + 2 and y = 2k − 1 is a solution of the equation 4x − 3y + 1 = 0.
Find the value of p if x = p and y = 2 is a solution of the equation 3x − 4y = 7.
quiz.explanation: Substitute x = p and y = 2 into 3x − 4y = 7: 3(p) − 4(2) = 7 → 3p − 8 = 7 → 3p = 15 → p = 5.

topics.title: Lines Parallel to the Axes
topics.concept:
An equation with only one variable still draws a line in the plane. x = k is a vertical line through (k, 0), parallel to the y-axis; y = k is a horizontal line through (0, k), parallel to the x-axis.

So x = 0 is the y-axis itself and y = 0 is the x-axis. Word problems often translate a relationship into such an equation, then a graph.

examples.solution: A vertical line crossing the x-axis at 3, parallel to the y-axis.

recap: x = k is vertical; y = k is horizontal.
x = 0 is the y-axis; y = 0 is the x-axis.

quiz.q: In an auto-rickshaw fare system in New Delhi, the fare for the first kilometre is ₹20 and for subsequent distance it is ₹12 per km. If the total distance covered is x km and total fare is ₹y, write the linear equation.
quiz.explanation: Total distance = x km. Distance after 1st km = (x − 1) km. Fare for 1st km = ₹20. Fare for remaining distance = 12(x − 1). Total fare y = 20 + 12(x − 1) = 20 + 12x − 12 = 12x + 8.

quiz.q: A structural pillar is constructed using pre-cast segments. The total height y (in meters) after adding x segments is given by y = 2.5x + 1.5. If the total height reached is 14 meters, how many segments were used?
quiz.explanation: Substitute y = 14 into the equation: 14 = 2.5x + 1.5 → 14 − 1.5 = 2.5x → 12.5 = 2.5x → x = 12.5 / 2.5 = 5 segments.

questions.q: Find the point on the graph of 3x + 4y = 24 whose x-coordinate is double its y-coordinate.
questions.explanation: Since the x-coordinate is double the y-coordinate, let x = 2y. Substitute x = 2y into 3x + 4y = 24: 3(2y) + 4y = 24 → 6y + 4y = 24 → 10y = 24 → y = 2.4. Then x = 2(2.4) = 4.8. The point is (4.8, 2.4).

questions.q: The graph of the linear equation 2x + 3y = 6 cuts the y-axis at the point:
questions.explanation: A graph cuts the y-axis where x = 0. Substituting x = 0 in 2x + 3y = 6 gives 2(0) + 3y = 6 → 3y = 6 → y = 2. Thus, the point is (0, 2).

questions.q: A group of friends goes out to a local eatery in Bengaluru. They order x plates of idli at ₹30 per plate and y cups of filter coffee at ₹15 per cup. The total bill amounts to ₹120. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Cost of x plates of idli = 30x. Cost of y cups of coffee = 15y. Total cost is 30x + 15y = 120.

questions.q: A straight line passes through the point (a, a) and is perpendicular to the x-axis. What is its linear equation representation?
questions.explanation: A line perpendicular to the x-axis is a vertical line. Vertical lines have equations of the form x = k. Since it passes through (a, a), the x-coordinate must always be a. Hence, the equation is x = a.

questions.q: The value of k for which the linear equation kx − y = 2 has a solution where x is always 1 more than y, and passing through (3, 2), is:
questions.explanation: The solution point given is (3, 2). Substitute x = 3 and y = 2 into the equation kx − y = 2: k(3) − 2 = 2 → 3k = 4 → k = 4/3.

questions.q: If the graph of the linear equation 5x + 2y = 20 forms a triangle with the coordinate axes, find the area of this triangle.
questions.explanation: Find intercepts: y = 0 → 5x = 20 → x = 4. x = 0 → 2y = 20 → y = 10. The right-angled triangle has a base of 4 units along the x-axis and a height of 10 units along the y-axis. Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 4 × 10 = 20 sq units.

questions.q: If x = 1, y = 2 is a solution of the equation a²x + ay = 3, then the possible values of a are:
questions.explanation: Substitute x = 1 and y = 2 into the equation: a²(1) + a(2) = 3 → a² + 2a − 3 = 0. Solving this quadratic equation: (a + 3)(a − 1) = 0 → a = 1 or a = −3.

questions.q: The cost of a notebook is twice the cost of a pen. Writing this statement as a linear equation in two variables (where x is cost of notebook and y is cost of pen) gives:
questions.explanation: Let cost of notebook = x and cost of pen = y. According to the given statement: Cost of notebook = 2 × Cost of pen → x = 2y → x − 2y = 0.

questions.q: The coordinates of a point on the line x + 2y = 8 whose y-coordinate is half its x-coordinate is:
questions.explanation: Given y-coordinate is half of x-coordinate, so x = 2y. Substitute x = 2y into x + 2y = 8: 2y + 2y = 8 → 4y = 8 → y = 2. Then x = 2(2) = 4. The point is (4, 2).

questions.q: The graph of the linear equation x = k is a line parallel to the:
questions.explanation: The equation x = k represents a line where the x-coordinate is always k, regardless of the value of y. This forms a straight vertical line parallel to the y-axis.

questions.q: The graph of ax + by + c = 0 is a straight line passing through the origin if and only if:
questions.explanation: If a line passes through the origin (0, 0), then substituting x = 0 and y = 0 must satisfy its equation: a(0) + b(0) + c = 0 → c = 0.

questions.q: Look at the pattern: Term 1 = 5, Term 2 = 9, Term 3 = 13, Term 4 = 17. If y represents the value of the term and x represents the term number, which equation represents this rule?
questions.explanation: Test y = 4x + 1. For x = 1: y = 4(1)+1 = 5. For x = 2: y = 4(2)+1 = 9. For x = 3: y = 4(3)+1 = 13. This linear equation perfectly matches the given values.

questions.q: The total weight of a box containing x identical cricket balls (each weighing 150 grams) and a container weighing 200 grams is given by y grams. Write the linear expression.
questions.explanation: The total weight y is the sum of the combined weight of x balls (150 grams each) and the constant weight of the empty container (200 grams). Therefore, y = 150x + 200.
A linear equation in two variables represents a straight line. Since a line contains infinitely many points, the equation has infinitely many solutions.
